scope: Four independent fresh-process OFF diagnostics with rare GC start/stop events recorded in a preallocated buffer. No observer sampling, no optimization/candidate, no GC disabling/forced collection/threshold changes. No field/hardware/USB/human/GUI/SDK/Run; not a calibration or replacement A/A.
checks: Retain all three predeclared pairs including any failing performance blocks; do not replace or lower15% limits. Abort on capture/cleanup errors and preserve locks/PIDs/logs.

All full original outputs and458 frozen source files and6 input hashes exact. Final binary hash matches deterministic control; address0 disables only synthetic probes, not the external lock/read/unwind path.

Separate full host/QPC brackets, actual sample count/order, native PID/TID handles, GetThreadTimes/thread_time and cycles. At least38/40 full sample brackets in contact ROI. No sample-index time reconstruction.
Absolute relative changes of total wall/CPU/cycles and every fixed1000-input wall block must stay <=15%. Root/PDB field quality is not implied by raw stream termination.
Only original consumer chain is measured. No reader queue/pending, GUI painting, visual callbacks or real SDK child is emulated or attributed. Full actual-load calibration remains false.
source_change: Only JSON output publication is staged+fsync+same-directory rename. No processing function, capture binary, workload, semantic check or performance threshold changed.

analysis_rules.independent_unit: whole fresh replay pair; blocks correlated, not independent replicates
analysis_rules.changing_cpu_delivery: Report drift/CPU/cycles; do not convert cycles to frequency or post-hoc normalize away wall changes.
analysis_rules.future_sample_size: Derived once after this pilot with explicit maximum; inconclusive if precision insufficient.

limits: Added GC callback can perturb GC schedule; results do not retrospectively identify the cause of prior A/A slow blocks. Exact output/hash/counter checks retained; no event-derived function time shares.
